Rationale.RP1_ImplementationReconstructability: The plan.md clearly describes objectives, hypotheses, methodology, and expected results. CodeWalkthrough.md provides repository structure and usage. Source code in src/ is well-documented with docstrings. Notebooks demonstrate exact methodology with output examples. Dataset generation and intervention logic can be reconstructed without major guesswork.
Rationale.RP2_EnvironmentReproducibility: pyproject.toml specifies dependencies with versions. uv.lock provides exact versions for reproducibility. env.yml documents environment variables. nnsight library (0.4.6) is specified and compatible. Models accessible via HuggingFace. Environment can be restored without unresolved issues.
Rationale.RP3_DeterminismAndStability: Random seeds are set in notebooks (random.seed(10) or 42). Experiments use deterministic operations (argmax). Dataset generation is reproducible with fixed seeds. Intervention effects were stable across samples. Layer-wise patterns consistent across runs.
Rationale.RP4_DemoPresentation: Multiple notebooks serve as demos (answer_lookback.ipynb, binding_lookback.ipynb, explicit_visibility_exps.ipynb). Each includes clear headers, complete code, output cells with expected results, and references to paper figures. Demos executable without external materials.
